citation: Acton, C.H. (1996) Ancillary data services of NASA's Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility, Planet. Space Sci. 44(1), 65-70. Kernels from NAIF generic_kernels.
note: The loader furnishes exactly one MOON_ME frame kernel: moon_de440_250416.tf when present, otherwise the predecessor release moon_de440_220930.tf (same MOON_PA_DE440 -> MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 chain, defines the MOON_ME alias). scripts/fetch_data.sh tries NAIF first for both and falls back to a public verbatim mirror when NAIF is unreachable.

kernels.purpose: Body radii (Earth radius for apparent disk)
High-accuracy lunar orientation (MOON_PA_DE440), includes physical libration
Defines MOON_ME = MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 (DE421 mean-Earth frame used by LOLA products); preferred release
Predecessor MOON_ME frame kernel; fallback used only when the 250416 release is unavailable (documented in docs/DECISION_LOG.md)
